messages:
jun: thinking about supporting both grpc-unary and grpc-stream for internal inference. streaming helps long outputs and reduces chattiness. what tradeoffs are folks worried about?
leah: streaming is powerful but browser SDKs + legacy services struggle. WebSocket or http2 fallback required.
mike: gateway can translate stream -> websocket for browsers, but that adds complexity and statefulness.
rana: major concern: quota and auth semantics per chunk vs per session. current quota is per-request token-bucket, streaming breaks that model.
jun: agree. proposal: quota by session with a leak-rate tied to chunk size. same quota service, new session token check then charge per-chunk.
leah: observability: need to show live progress (chunks emitted) vs total completion latency. Console should surface per-session chunk histogram.
mike: Console idea: "streaming sessions" dashboard w/ active sessions, avg chunks, tail latency, and chunk error heatmap.
ops-bot: note: current healthcheck flips unhealthy if in-flight streams > 1000 (legacy threshold).
jun: that's a bug — healthcheck should evaluate stream backlog separately from normal request QPS. filing infra ticket.
rana: security: internal services prefer mTLS, external clients use JWT via gateway. gateway maps JWT -> metadata (x-subject) for backend. need to document header->metadata mapping.
leah: also think about proto options: add service-level flag `option (redwood.streaming) = true;` so codegen + linters know intent.
mike: compatibility: gateway translation must accept unknown fields and drop them with a deprecation log. streaming increases surface for proto drift.
rana: routing policy: prefer local gRPC replica (same region), fallback to gateway cross-region. want cost SLO + latency weight in the routing decision.
jun: routing config sketch for Console: 
```
route: /v2/stream/predict
protocols: [grpc-unary, grpc-stream, http-json]
routing: [{type: prefer_region, weight: 0.8}, {type: fallback_gateway, weight: 0.2}]
canary: {mode: session, value: 5}%
```
leah: note `canary.mode=session` so existing sessions aren't rebalanced mid-flight. important for long-lived streams.
mike: ops note: gateway must preserve trace id across translation. include `x-original-trace` header so Console traces stitch.
ops-bot: canary-start: /v2/stream/predict protocol=grpc-stream mode=session percent=2
ops-bot: canary-metrics: sessions=2000, grpc_stream_sessions=40, gateway_stream_sessions=1960, avg_chunks_per_session=12, error_rate=0.6%
jun: gateway_stream_sessions high — why are clients hitting gateway instead of native grpc? probably SDK defaults.
leah: action: add client-side opt-in flag to prefer grpc when environment supports http2 + mTLS. also update browser SDK docs to prefer websocket->grpc-stream translation.
mike: infra actions: 1) add session quota semantics to quota service 2) healthcheck fix for in-flight streams 3) gateway trace header + stream metrics 4) Console streaming dashboard 5) proto lint rule for streaming option
rana: i'll own quota semantics test harness. leah will own Console UI. jun + mike will pair on gateway translation.
leah: quick sync in 20. :thumbsup:
